decision_rationale: The donor skill workflow exposes useful staged source, analysis, reporting, and review semantics; Trading Gym reimplements them as a closed evidence contract without loading skills.
invariant: All sources, nodes, artifacts, sets, chronology, dependencies, capabilities, and review outputs reproduce and satisfy policy.
negative_invariant: No skill, model, tool, network client, publisher, adviser, payment, credential, or order path is executed or authorised.

decision_rationale: Search and agent skills commonly assume network, tool, and execution authority. The target keeps only the planning metadata and blocks consequential capabilities.
invariant: Requested capabilities are explicit and intersected with a closed target policy.
negative_invariant: Code execution and other consequential capabilities block readiness.

value_unit: grounded streaming UI event and block projection
decision_rationale: The donor separates chat, tool, and generated-UI concepts. Trading Gym preserves that user outcome as immutable event, tool-result, and source-bound block projections.
invariant: Events are contiguous, parented, bounded, redacted, and grounded in declared tool results and sources.
negative_invariant: Projection state cannot execute tools, mutate UI authority, load external assets, disclose secrets, pay, or trade.

decision_rationale: Interactive financial-agent clients combine streamed state and actionable components. The target converts those risks into explicit sequence and mutation guards.
invariant: Every projected state transition is ordered and non-mutating.
negative_invariant: Sequence gaps and mutating actions are rejected.

decision_rationale: The donor contributes useful specialised-agent, section, artifact, chart, and report assembly concepts. They are recomposed into a target-owned point-in-time evidence graph.
invariant: Sources, assignments, artifacts, sections, charts, reviews, sets, and final report hashes reproduce with complete coverage and role separation.
negative_invariant: No fetch, model execution, publication, advice, portfolio mutation, or order submission occurs.

decision_rationale: Generated reports and charts require independent review and explicit data lineage. The target rejects self-review and charts bound to non-data artifacts.
invariant: The final reviewer is distinct and charts bind only to admitted data artifacts.
negative_invariant: Self-review and ungrounded charts block readiness.

decision_rationale: All sixteen uploads must remain accountable even when only selected semantics become runtime contracts.
invariant: Exactly 16 donors and 13,238 regular surfaces are present with five new and eleven exact-repeat identities.
negative_invariant: Missing, duplicate, case-colliding, symlinked, or unclassified evidence blocks saturation.

decision_rationale: Searchable donor evidence supports omission review without executing or installing donors.
invariant: Search is bounded, deterministic, filterable, and returns hash-bound metadata only.
negative_invariant: Search cannot fetch links, execute donor code, or grant authority.

decision_rationale: Assessment and search capabilities are useful only when tool metadata preserves read-only, non-destructive, idempotent, closed-world behaviour.
invariant: Every wave-eighteen tool is read-only, non-destructive, idempotent, and closed-world.
negative_invariant: No assessment tool gains network, mutation, donor-runtime, or execution authority.

decision_rationale: Operators need reproducible local assessment entrypoints without embedding donor services or UI servers.
invariant: Commands accept explicit bounded local evidence and emit machine-readable reports.
negative_invariant: Commands cannot fetch, execute donors, publish, advise, mutate, or trade.

value_unit: exact-repeat identity and inert package resources
decision_rationale: Prior decisions may be reused only for archives that match byte-for-byte. Packaged catalogues remain inert resources.
invariant: Five donors are new, eleven are exact repeats, and all four wave-eighteen JSON resources are packaged.
negative_invariant: Filename similarity cannot establish repeat identity or activate donor content.

value_unit: donor backtest, scheduler, model, notification, portfolio, and execution runtime
decision_rationale: Trading Gym already owns provider, scheduler, backtest, portfolio, notification, governance, and execution authorities. Importing the donor runtime would duplicate sources of truth and amplify credentials and side effects.
invariant: Donor files remain evidence; only target-owned read-only contracts are registered.
negative_invariant: No fin_agent, FinRobot, generated-UI backend, or donor-named runtime module is imported or registered.
